title: mri_3d_photo_recon
description: Code for 3D photo reconstruction (Tregidgo, et al., MICCAI 2020)

input_segmentation_dir.description: Directory with input slab masks / segmentations (required)
input_segmentation_dir.title: Input Segmentation Directory

photo_resolution.description: Resolution of the photos in mm
photo_resolution.title: Photo Resolution

output_directory.description: Output directory with reconstructed photo volume and reference
output_directory.title: Output Directory

mesh_reorient_with_indices.description: Vertex indices of frontal pole, occipital pole, and top of central sulcus, separated with commas, for mesh alignment
mesh_reorient_with_indices.title: Mesh Reorient Indices

photos_posterior_side.description: Use when photos are taken of posterior side of slabs (default is anterior side)
photos_posterior_side.title: Photos Posterior Side Flag

order_posterior_to_anterior.description: Use when photos are ordered from posterior to anterior (default is anterior to posterior)
order_posterior_to_anterior.title: Order Posterior to Anterior Flag

allow_z_stretch.description: Use to adjust the slice thickness to best match the reference. You should probably *never* use this with soft references (ref_soft_mask)
allow_z_stretch.title: Allow Z Stretch Flag

rigid_only_for_photos.description: Switch on if you want photos to deform only rigidly (not affine)
rigid_only_for_photos.title: Rigid Only for Photos Flag
